meta.title: feat: Copy Button
meta.body:
### Overview
Adds a `CopyButton` component to the design system. Writes text to the clipboard and reflects an `idle -> copied/error -> idle` status machine with an auto-resetting timeout. Folder structure, styling conventions, and facade pattern mirror `SegmentedControl` / `StarRating`.

### Changelog
- `CopyButton.types.ts` — `CopyStatuses` (`as const` + `ValueOf`), `CopyButtonProps` (`text`, `timeout`, `onCopy`, `onError`, render-prop `children`).
- `CopyButton.facade.ts` — `useCopyButtonFacade`: async `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, status state, timeout reset with unmount cleanup, `useStableCallback`.
- `CopyButton.tsx` — semantic `button`, copy/check icon swap, `data-status` attribute, `aria-live="polite"`, optional label render prop.
- `CopyButton.module.scss` — scoped CSS custom props, `to-rem`, `button-reset` mixin, per-status color tokens, theme-color TODOs.
- `CopyButton.stories.tsx` — Default, CustomTimeout, CustomLabels.
- `CopyButton.test.tsx` — 5 vitest + RTL tests (idle, copy success, timeout reset, error path, custom label).
- Exported from `src/index.ts` and folder `index.ts`.

### Notes
- Graceful fallback: throws (-> error state + `onError`) when the Clipboard API is unavailable rather than silently failing.
- Colors flagged with `// TODO: theme color`, matching existing placeholder convention.

### Verification
- `npx vitest run src/components/CopyButton` — 5 passing.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean for CopyButton (pre-existing Carousel error unrelated).
- `npx biome check` + `stylelint` — clean.
